anti_overlap: Does not evaluate Notion DB relation design or sync mechanics (fd-notion-architecture)
Does not evaluate PRD acceptance criteria specificity (fd-prd-craft)
Does not evaluate agent coordination and world-model design (fd-agent-infra-design)
decision_lens: Would the operator, after a two-week absence, be able to reconstruct an accurate portfolio state and reprioritize work in under 10 minutes using only the substrate described in these docs?
focus: Evaluate the portfolio management model for prioritization coherence, capacity visibility, cross-project dependency surfacing, and the operator's ability to detect strategic drift across 42 projects.
name: fd-multi-project-portfolio
persona: Apply the perspective of a portfolio manager running a solo-operator multi-project system — they care about whether priority signals propagate without manual overhead, whether dormant vs active project states are explicitly tracked, whether cross-project blocking dependencies are surfaced before they cause context-switch thrash, and whether the system degrades gracefully as portfolio size grows beyond 50 projects.
review_areas: Assess whether 'dormant vs active' project states are formally defined — the vision doc references agents should know which projects are dormant, but no status taxonomy is specified.

Evaluate whether the priority propagation model (portfolio-beads priority → per-project beads priority) is pull, push, or operator-triggered — the CUJ says per-project is NOT auto-updated, but doesn't say how the operator knows a downstream cascade is needed.
Check whether the '>50 initiatives' failure mode in the CUJ is addressed by any structural feature (views by domain, staleness tiers) or only named as a future mitigation.
Review whether the Sessions DB decision (F4) has a defined impact on portfolio state visibility — if sessions are dropped, what replaces 'live agent activity' as a portfolio-level signal.

Assess whether the two-year horizon features (portfolio-aware dispatch, cross-project pattern detection) impose constraints on Month 1 schema that aren't currently captured as non-goals or forward-compatibility notes.
Evaluate whether the operator's 'steer next' goal has an explicit triage model — P0/P1 filter is mentioned, but multi-project capacity (one human, many parallel agents) isn't modeled.

severity_examples.condition: Agent behavior that depends on undefined schema fields cannot be implemented correctly.
severity_examples.scenario: Project status taxonomy (dormant/active/archived) is referenced in the vision but not defined in any schema or PRD feature, leaving the 'agents skip dormant projects' behavior unimplementable.

severity_examples.condition: Without a drift-detection mechanism, priority changes silently age out and the portfolio diverges from per-project reality.
severity_examples.scenario: Priority propagation from portfolio-beads to per-project beads is operator-manual with no mechanism to surface which per-project beads are now misaligned with updated portfolio priorities.

severity_examples.condition: Schema designed without forward-compatibility hints requires breaking migrations when v2 features are built.
severity_examples.scenario: The two-year horizon's 'portfolio-aware dispatch' feature likely requires agent-identity fields on Sessions and Initiatives rows that aren't hinted at in the Month 1 schema.

success_hints: Project status taxonomy has at least three named states with transition criteria
Priority propagation model explicitly states how operator learns about cascade needs
Views by domain or staleness are specced as future requirements, not just mentioned in failure modes
Sessions DB strategy decision (F4) includes impact statement on portfolio-level activity visibility
task_context: The ideagui foundation is designed to give a solo operator a unified view of 42 projects managed by a human + AI fleet. The review goal is to identify gaps in the portfolio management model — prioritization, project state taxonomy, cross-project dependencies — that would make the substrate accurate today but brittle or misleading at scale.
